node.title: Re^6: Grep logs by start date and end date in different directories (updated)
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
However what happens if I want to read multiple bz2 files instead of 1 bz2 file?

You should just be able to put the code you showed in a loop, for example my @files = ("debug.log.bz2", "debug2.log.bz2", ...); for my $filename (@files) { my $fh = ... }.

Update: If you're the same anonymous poster, then you seem to have already figured that out [id://1206886|here]. You might want to consider [id://101|registering an account] so that your threads can be more easily connected, and so that you can [id://17557|edit] your posts instead of making multiple anonymous "update" posts. Even if you [id://1206946|already have an account] you can still register a second one for use at work as long as you observe the [id://538727].
